sections.title: Heart Containers
sections.note: Link's life meter starts at 4 bars; each container adds one, up to 8.

items.name: Parapa Desert forest
items.area: Parapa Desert, south of Parapa Palace
items.howTo: Cross the small valley south of the palace and step onto the grass in the middle of a small forest. A Goriya guards it.

items.name: Midoro Swamp cave
items.howTo: Two boulders block two caves facing each other: break the eastern one with the Hammer (the other cave holds a 200-point bag).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's heart container pages start from the rock south of Rauru instead; it's the same cave.

items.name: Sea north of the Palace on the Sea
items.howTo: Wearing the Boots, follow the hidden path toward the Palace on the Sea but take its branch north, then east, to a small island.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's wiki says to start east of Mido; Mido is in Western Hyrule, so Nabooru is used.

items.name: Coast near Three-Eye Rock
items.howTo: Get past the River Devil south of Nabooru with the Flute, then walk the beach to a hidden screen. A wall in an empty New Kasuto house hints at it.

sections.title: Magic Containers
sections.note: The magic meter starts at 4 bars, up to 8. Spell needs 7 and Thunder all 8.

items.name: Cave south of North Castle
items.howTo: In the dark cave just south of where Link starts; the Candle lights it.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki says southeast of North Castle, Zelda Dungeon's old guide southwest; the others say south.

items.name: Spectacle Rock
items.howTo: Smash the boulder just west of the Hammer's cave and drop into the hole.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki says it's in the eastern cavern, under a rock.

items.name: Maze Island
items.howTo: In a hidden pit along the island's west side.
items.notes: StrategyWiki's walkthrough says the northwest corner; its own list and the other sources say the west or southwest.

items.name: New Kasuto
items.howTo: An old woman in blue lets Link into her basement once his magic meter has 7 bars, so collect the other three first.
